summary: D-03 now uses a dedicated 53번 data-analysis writing workspace. The page shows a writing command header, step flow, left-side prompt/materials/rubric support column, right-side intro/body/conclusion editor, char and paragraph status, autosave controls, submit confirmation, and a live manuscript preview.
acceptedVariance: The active q53 draft contract stores structured sections in answer_json and a flattened answer_text. Editing therefore remains in section fields while the manuscript grid is a live preview.
The hifi includes decorative tutor imagery and secondary toolbar actions that are not required by description.md and are not added as net-new behavior in this audit.
Next dev indicator may appear in local screenshots. It is not product UI and is excluded from visual severity.
